derived_info.summary: JP-10 (Octahydro-1H-4,7-methanoindene, CAS# 2825-82-3) is a specialized jet fuel and gas turbine fuel primarily used for missiles and military aerospace applications. It is characterized by its high energy density and low freezing point, making it particularly suitable for demanding aerospace environments. The product is a clear, colorless liquid with a purity of 98.5-100%, a flash point of 55-65°C, and a heat of combustion of at least 42.1 MJ/kg. It maintains good flow properties at low temperatures, with kinematic viscosity below 10 cSt at -18°C and below 40 cSt at -54°C. JP-10 is very stable under normal conditions but requires proper storage away from moisture, high temperatures, ignition sources, and oxidizing materials. Handling requires appropriate personal protective equipment including chemical goggles, impenetrable gloves, and adequate ventilation to avoid breathing vapors.

personas.sales_summary: JP-10 is a premium, high-performance jet fuel specifically engineered for military aerospace applications where exceptional energy density and low-temperature performance are critical. With a guaranteed minimum heat of combustion of 42.1 MJ/kg and excellent flow properties even at temperatures as low as -54°C, this product delivers superior performance in missile propulsion systems and specialized gas turbine applications. Its high purity (98.5-100%) and stability under normal conditions ensure reliable operation in demanding military environments. JP-10 represents a specialized offering in our fuel portfolio, addressing the unique requirements of defense contractors and military applications where standard aviation fuels cannot meet the extreme performance demands.
personas.technical_summary: JP-10 (Octahydro-1H-4,7-methanoindene) is a high-energy-density missile fuel with CAS# 2825-82-3. This clear, colorless liquid has a purity of 98.5-100%, flash point of 55-65°C, and heat of combustion of minimum 42.1 MJ/kg. Its low-temperature performance is exceptional, maintaining viscosity below 10 cSt at -18°C and below 40 cSt at -54°C, with specific gravity of 0.934-0.943 (60/60F) and Saybolt color of 25+. The product is chemically stable under normal conditions but should be stored away from moisture, high temperatures, ignition sources, and oxidizing materials. Handling requires protective chemical goggles, impenetrable gloves, and adequate ventilation. In case of skin or eye contact, immediate flushing with water for at least 15 minutes is required, with medical attention for eye exposure.
